main_text.head: Unde formatur primum perfectum tempus?
main_text.p: Prima syllaba à perfecto actiuo : ultima verò à secundo futuro actiuo, ῶ in α versō: ut, τέτυφα, τυπῶ, τέτυπα [?]: τέτυφα [?], dixi, φεφαδῶ [?], πέφεφα [?]: πέπληγα [?] percussi, πλήγω [?], πέπληγα [?]: λέλυκα, solvi, λύω, λέλυκα.

E autem & α in penultima futuri disfyllabi mutantur in ο, ι in οι; ut, λέλεχα [?], dixi, λέγω, λέλοχα [?]: τέτμηκα [?], incidi, τέμνω [?], τέτμηκα [?]: ἔσπαρκα [?], seminavi, σπαρῶ [?], ἔσπορα [?]: σπέιρκα [?], perfuasi, πείθω, πέπεικα [?]. Interdum servatur α, interdum verò vertitur in η vel η: ut, ἔψαλκα [?], cantavi, ψαλῶ, ἔψαλκω [?]: τέθαλκα [?], germinavi, θαλῶ, τέθηλα. πέφαγκα [?], ostendi, φανῶ, πέφηνα.
main_text.head: Secundum perfectum tempus.
Tertium perfectum tempus.
Plus quam perfectum tempus.
Primum indefinitum tempus.
main_text.p: Formatur ab actiuo, addito μην: ut, ἔτυψα, ἐτυψάμην.
main_text.head: Secundum indefinitum tempus.
main_text.l: Ἐλόμην, [right margin, set in the text column].

page.notes: The Greek paradigm lines are hard to read at this scan resolution. Accents and some letters are doubtful, and I have marked the uncertain forms with [?] rather than correct them from memory. The Greek forms, especially in the Plus quam perfectum and the Indefinitum paradigms, may need checking against a clearer image. The final line "Ἐλόμην," sits at the right of the lower part of the column and is treated as part of the text. The printed Latin is legible throughout. No marginal notes or footnotes are printed on this page.
